ud1.1:1.1: Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa. Evam me sutam.
ud1.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā Nerañjarāya tīre bodhirukkhamūle paṭhamābhisambuddho.
ud1.1:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisinno hoti vimuttisukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedī.
ud1.1:1.4: atha kho bhagavā tassa sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ paṭiccasamuppādaṃ anulomaṃ sādhukaṃ manas' ākāsi
ud1.1:2.1: iti: imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti, imass' uppādā idaṃ uppajjati, yadidaṃ:
ud1.1:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
